symptom: A widget `show_page` whose target page is created later in the same script passes `mxcli check --references` but the executor fails with "page not found … defined later in this script"
cause: The whole-script scriptContext used by reference validation tolerates forward refs (the page exists *somewhere*); the executor resolves page refs in statement order
insight: An ordered pass flags a widget page ref that is neither in the project nor created earlier in the script, with the same "move the create statement earlier" hint the executor gives — keeping check consistent with execution. Issue #674
